title: Adapt a third-party analytics SDK
description: Your app tracks events through a Tracker interface with a single track(event, data) method. The vendor SDK you must use has a completely different API: Analytics.recordEvent(name, properties). Write an AnalyticsAdapter that implements Tracker and delegates to Analytics — without changing either the Tracker interface or the Analytics class.
hints: AnalyticsAdapter should hold a reference to an Analytics instance
track(event, data) should call analytics.recordEvent(event, data) with the matching arguments
Neither Tracker nor Analytics should be modified
issues: The app is coupled to the vendor SDK's method names and signatures throughout the codebase
Swapping analytics providers would require changing every call site
overallGoal: Use the Adapter pattern to let your app talk to the vendor SDK through the Tracker interface it already expects, keeping the rest of the codebase unaware of the vendor's API.
goals: track() delegates to Analytics.recordEvent() with the correct arguments
The app can use AnalyticsAdapter wherever a Tracker is expected
